decision: clear for the declared single bounded child-attribution successor; source review only
scope: All 12 changed/new source and test paths read, including complete helper, startup/activation/reader integration, orchestration and exact source diff. Prior unchanged observer core retains its separate peer.
findings: The one untimed -I -c metadata probe runs the exact admitted private-venv executable before observer installation and before the original population. Its fixed program imports only standard-library metadata facilities.

Probe admission checks the invoked executable, exact private prefix, parent Python version/platform and every argument after argv0. A different absolute argv0 is admitted only for the observed Darwin framework representation.

The registered executable image is bounded and stable before/after the probe; the actual observed argv0 image is separately hashed. These are preparation-time image observations, not new process-executable attestation.

Actual registered subprocess argv is unchanged. Startup and activate require exact executable, parent PID, isolation, mapped complete observed argv, sealed profile/config bytes and version. Duplicate mapped registrations are refused.
Schema v2 retains separate registered and observed argv hashes. The parent reader requires both exact values; it does not silently relabel old v1 reports.

Probe nonzero exit, stderr, timeout, identity/version/prefix/argument/unsupported-transform failures prevent the original workload. Missing sidecars, loss, incomplete joins and cleanup remain failure.
Original selected 8 preflight plus conditional 16 Claude PostToolUse offers, product and artifact identities, native joins, decisions, deadlines and original exception behavior are unchanged.

meaningful_controls_read: wrong observed argv0 and duplicate registration startup refusal

limits: The original six Mac startup failures did not retain orig_argv, so the framework explanation remains a source-supported hypothesis until fresh metadata is observed.
The fixed metadata process is direct-child bounded by subprocess.run timeout; this is not a general descendant containment proof.
Interpreter and OS caches may be affected by metadata preparation; no clean performance or full qualification claim follows.
The source receipt may support exact helper reuse in the Cline diagnostic, but it does not replace the separate Cline witness/driver review.
The final bound driver requires its concrete operational delta review before launch.
